brief: North Macedonia's commercial banks publish their primary disclosure almost entirely in Macedonian on their own sites, and the shape of that publication varies sharply by bank: Стопанска банка and Комерцијална банка run true IR hubs (share data, assembly minutes, dividend tables, a named IR officer at Стопанска), НЛБ splits shareholder material between a modern /za-bankata/za-akcionerite tree and a legacy Cyrillic-path ASPX archive, while Халкбанк, ТТК, УНИБанка, ЦКБ, Шпаркасе, ПроКредит and Капитал банка instead expose report folders or numbered shareholder-assembly document packs with highly predictable, enumerable URL patterns. Three second-layer channels — the Macedonian Stock Exchange issuer pages, SEINET and the SEC's SRIS repository — mirror the same bank-authored PDFs and should be used as a completeness and timestamping check, since some banks (notably Халкбанк, on the free market) route dividend and financial-data notices there rather than through an IR page of their own. The main operational risks for this cell are technical rather than legal: percent-encoded Cyrillic paths that must not be normalised, a kb.com.mk-to-kb.mk redirect, and at least one report listing (Халкбанк) that does not render in plain HTML extraction. The universe is not yet complete — the NBRSM per-bank registry should be scraped to seed every licensed institution, with Силк Роуд Банка the known open item.
